character: Traditional old mountain village below Vallandry. Original Savoyard stone hamlet. Linked to Vallandry by gondola. More authentic feel than purpose-built Arcs villages. Quiet, charming, good for families.
dining: Local village restaurants, Savoyard cuisine, pizzerias.
activities_nearby: Gondola to Vallandry ski area. Access to Paradiski (425km). Hiking, snowshoeing.
